concepts.def: Group of individuals of the same species in the same area at the same time who can interbreed.
Total of all alleles of all genes in a population at a given time.
Proportion of a given allele in the gene pool, expressed as a decimal or percentage.
p² + 2pq + q² = 1; estimates genotype frequencies when no evolutionary forces act on a population.
Random change in allele frequency, more pronounced in small populations.
Sharp reduction in population size that reduces genetic diversity and changes allele frequencies.
